subject: Intro & discovery — Redwood x Synthex (post-call exec recap)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Karen Li <karen.li@synthex.com>, Tom Reddy <tom.reddy@synthex.com>
Cc: Elliot White <elliot.white@synthex.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Intro & discovery — Redwood x Synthex

Hi Karen / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from my side while everything is still fresh. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you described:
- Production latency spikes and unpredictable per-token costs on your current hosted LLM endpoints (esp. peak traffic during product launches).
- Lack of consistent model serving across cloud regions and gaps in auditability for PII-sensitive flows.
- Engineering time spent tuning inference infra instead of product features.

Goals / desired outcomes:
- 50% reduction in per-token inference spend via smarter batching/caching and quantization strategies within 3–6 months.
- Sub-200ms 95th percentile latency for user-facing classification flows.
- VPC/private deployment + KMS integration for regulatory compliance in your EU and US regions.

Stakeholders we heard:
- Karen Li — Chief Product Officer (primary exec sponsor)
- Tom Reddy — VP Eng (technical decision-maker)
- Elliot White — Procurement (contract and timelines)

Procurement path & timeline you indicated:
- Competitive evaluation through end of May; shortlist decision by mid-June.
- Expect legal/IT security review in parallel; target PO by end of Q3.

Open risks / escalation items:
- Need SOC 2 / data residency proof during security review (you mentioned this as a gating item).
- Integration work for private deployment could add ~4–6 weeks depending on network/infra team availability.

Next steps (agreed):
1) I will send a follow-up exec one-pager + demo recording and a draft MOA for review (by tomorrow).
2) Technical deep-dive with Tom and engineering team (1 hour) — propose week of 4/18.
3) Security questionnaire and SOC2 evidence delivery — assign to our security team and share by 4/20.

Attachments: Synthex_MOA_draft.pdf (initial scope), redwood-demo-recording.mp4 (meeting recording).

If that aligns, I can also draft a short mutual action plan we can share with procurement to keep timelines tight.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

---
Note: recording and MOA attached.

From: Karen Li <karen.li@synthex.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reddy <tom.reddy@synthex.com>, Elliot White <elliot.white@synthex.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 18:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro & discovery — Redwood x Synthex

Aditya —

This is perfect, thanks for the thorough recap. A few quick notes / clarifications:
- The 50% cost reduction is aspirational but would be transformative for us — Tom will want to see the assumptions behind that estimate.
- SOC 2 evidence is mandatory for us; can you confirm which reports and artifact sets you can provide during the security review?
- Procurement timeline: Elliot is aiming to have a PO ready by end of Q3 but wants to ensure pricing bands are locked before we start legal.

We'd like to schedule the technical deep-dive on 4/19 at 10am PT if that works for your side.

Thanks —
Karen
Chief Product Officer, Synthex Labs
karen.li@synthex.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karen Li <karen.li@synthex.com>, Tom Reddy <tom.reddy@synthex.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Exec recap: Synthex discovery — business outcomes, risks, procurement path (for leadership)

Laura / Marissa —

Looping you in with an exec-level recap from yesterday's discovery with Synthex (Karen Li / Tom Reddy). I'm tagging Marissa to start thinking about SOW / CS handoff — this looks like a mid-market expansion with enterprise sensitivity.

Why this matters (business outcomes):
- Upside ARR: conservative PO estimate is $180k ARR on initial reserved capacity + onboarding (year 1). Upside if they expand to multi-region private deployments.
- Strategic: Synthex is a high-visibility product team in the healthcare analytics space — positive case study for our private deployments and compliance story.

Technical/contract risks to address quickly:
- SOC 2 evidence and data residency guarantees (EU + US) are gating. Need security artifacts and a SOC 2 attestation letter.
- Integration window for VPC/private deployment could extend time-to-value; engineering capacity for a dedicated onboarding track may be needed.

Procurement path (as discussed):
- Discovery -> tech deep-dive (4/19) -> security review (target by 4/20 delivery on our side) -> pricing bands agreed -> legal/contracting -> PO by end of Q3.

Asks from leadership:
1) Approve prioritizing a security response (SOC2 pack) to be sent by 4/20. Approve access to our compliance folder for their security reviewers.
2) Approve one CS onboarding week reserved in May for VPC setup if they proceed (estimate 40 engineering hours).
3) Approve a flexible pilot pricing band we can present to Elliot to keep procurement moving; recommend a starter committed rate with a 90-day evaluation clause.

Attachments: Synthex_MOA_draft.pdf (scope & pricing bands). I'll follow with a short mutual action plan for Elliot.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com

Thanks for the clear summary. Approving the SOC2 pack delivery and reserving a CS onboarding sprint in May (40 hours). Marissa, please draft an initial SOW and the pilot pricing band geared to procurement — include the 90-day evaluation clause Aditya suggested.

Marissa — can you get a draft SOW and pricing to Elliot (cc'd previously) by EOD Thursday so procurement has something to review?

Laura
